summary_note: This tracker loads the latest repo snapshot. The button below checks GitHub for a newer snapshot at most once per day in this browser; official pricing pages can still change between repo refreshes.
history_note: History lines use official pricing snapshots that are stored in this repo. Some providers only have one official snapshot recorded so far, while others mix successive flagship or promo models.

api_pricing.notes: OpenAI's highest-capability GPT-5.6 model. Requests above 272K input tokens are billed at 2x input and 1.5x output rates; regional processing adds 10%.
OpenAI's balanced GPT-5.6 model at its current reduced standard rate. Requests above 272K input tokens are billed at 2x input and 1.5x output rates; regional processing adds 10%.
OpenAI's fastest and lowest-cost GPT-5.6 model at its current reduced standard rate. Requests above 272K input tokens are billed at 2x input and 1.5x output rates; regional processing adds 10%.

Current promotional standard-tier pricing for Google's most capable Flash model. On January 1, 2027, prices become $1.50 input, $0.15 cached input, and $7.50 output; cache storage also rises from $0.50 to $1.00 per 1M tokens per hour.
Google's current Gemini Developer API pricing page lists Gemma 4 with free input, output, and context caching, while the paid tier remains unavailable.
Generally available since June 9, 2026. Five-minute prompt-cache writes are $12.50 per 1M tokens; US-only inference is 1.1x standard pricing.
Invitation-only Project Glasswing model with the same underlying specifications and pricing as Claude Fable 5. It is not a self-serve API model and requires 30-day data retention.
api_pricing.source_label: Anthropic Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 announcement

api_pricing.notes: Anthropic's current generally available flagship model with a 1M-token context window. Five-minute prompt-cache writes are $6.25 per 1M tokens; US-only inference is 1.1x standard pricing.
Introductory pricing through August 31, 2026; standard pricing becomes $3 input, $0.30 cache read, and $15 output per 1M tokens. Prompt-cache writes are $2.50 during the introductory period.
Current V4 Flash version. Peak pricing applies 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC; all other hours receive DeepSeek's 50% off-peak discount. Numeric chart values use the conservative peak rate.
Current V4 Pro version. Peak pricing applies 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC; all other hours receive DeepSeek's 50% off-peak discount. Numeric chart values use the conservative peak rate.

Current international qwen3.7-max effective price after Alibaba Cloud's ongoing 50% discount; list prices are $2.50 input and $7.50 output. Explicit cache hits cost 10% of input and implicit cache hits 20%. Qwen3.8-Max-Preview is currently offered through the Token Plan rather than normal pay-as-you-go billing.
Together AI's public serverless price for Z AI's GLM-5.2, released June 16, 2026 with a 256K context window.
Moonshot AI's current open-weight flagship, with a 1M-token context window and native multimodal support.
Kimi K2.7 Code is Kimi’s current most capable coding model. The high-speed variant is $1.90 cache-miss input, $0.38 cache-hit input, and $8.00 output per 1M tokens.
Current overseas pay-as-you-go price for Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 Pro. The V2 compatibility models were fully deprecated on June 30, 2026; V2.5 Pro supports a 1M context window and up to 128K output.
Current global pay-as-you-go standard-service price. Requests from 512K to 1M tokens cost $0.60 input, $0.12 cache read, and $2.40 output; priority service is priced separately.
Current xAI flagship standard rate for requests up to 500K input tokens. Requests above 500K cost $4 input, $1 cached input, and $12 output per 1M tokens.
GitHub Copilot is sold as a subscription product. GitHub does not publicly publish a Copilot per-token API price comparable to the other vendors here.

Pro capabilities with 5x the Plus usage allowance. No annual billing.
Highest individual ChatGPT tier, with 20x the Plus usage allowance. No annual billing.
Standard ChatGPT seat for teams of two or more; pricing was reduced in April 2026. Flexible credits can extend included usage.
Individual plan; annual billing is equivalent to about $17 per month.
Five times the Pro usage allowance. Includes Claude Code and Claude Cowork.
Twenty times the Pro usage allowance. Includes Claude Code and Claude Cowork.
For teams of 5 to 150. Anthropic also lists Premium seats at $100 annually or $125 monthly per seat.
Individual plan with 2x Gemini usage limits and 400 GB of storage. Regional prices and storage bundles vary.
Individual plan with 4x Gemini usage limits and 5 TB of storage. Regional prices vary.
Higher-access Ultra tier with 5x the Pro usage limits and 20 TB of storage.
Highest-access Ultra tier with 20x the Pro usage limits and 30 TB of storage.
Fixed-price coding plan for supported Qwen and selected third-party models; request quotas apply.
Lite, Standard, and Pro individual tiers. The plan includes access to Qwen3.8-Max-Preview and uses rolling token-window quotas rather than pay-as-you-go token billing.

Annual Lite, Standard, Pro, and Max tiers.

benchmark_snapshot.note: Top 10 current models by Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. Speeds and available prices come from the benchmark snapshot; missing model-level prices are filled from the official provider prices reviewed above. Values can differ when multiple deployments or reasoning modes exist.

provider_leaderboard.note: Each provider rank uses that provider's best currently benchmarked endpoint for the selected metric, so the representative model can change across metrics.

intelligence.label: Intelligence Index
intelligence.description: Higher is better. Ranked by each provider's strongest currently benchmarked endpoint.

price.label: Blended price
price.description: Lower is better. Ranked by the provider's lowest currently benchmarked blended USD price (3:1 input/output mix).

latency.label: Latency
latency.description: Lower is better. Ranked by median time to first answer token for the provider's fastest currently benchmarked endpoint.

context_window.label: Context window
context_window.description: Higher is better. Ranked by the provider's largest currently benchmarked context window.

scale_price_frontier.note: Lines start in 2021 and combine curated source-backed historical records with the latest Artificial Analysis model metadata. Model size tracks the largest open-weight/open-access LLM by total disclosed parameters for each year, so sparse MoE and dense models are not quality-equivalent. Output-token price uses public USD text-token API prices and excludes tool-call, image, audio, video, and subscription pricing.
